notes:
### DaVinci Resolve connects on first install
- **Non-default Resolve install locations now work.** Cut Valet locates a
  running Resolve's own files instead of assuming the standard install
  folder, and it keeps retrying — opening Resolve *after* Cut Valet no
  longer leaves the connection disabled until you restart the app.
- **The status banner tells you what's actually wrong** — Resolve open but
  external scripting disabled (with the exact preference to flip), Resolve
  too old (with your installed version named), or Resolve's files not found
  — instead of a generic "isn't running" / "incompatible" guess.
- **Diagnostics name the real cause.** If the connection still fails, the
  Send Diagnostics report now contains the actual error, so we can fix it
  from one zip.

### AI Rough Cut
- **Day selection in chat:** tell the planner which shoot day(s) to cut and
  it scopes the rough cut to them; hand-offs are logged for review.
